climate_normalized_weight_formula.formula: α_k(w) = Σ_i w_i · AI_i · S_{i,k} / Σ_k Σ_i w_i · AI_i · S_{i,k}

CEV_formula_variance_form.formula: CEV(w,t) = Σ_k α_k^2 Var(B_{k,t}) + 2 Σ_{k<j} α_k α_j Cov(B_{k,t}, B_{j,t})

CEV_formula_expanded.formula: CEV(w,t) = Σ_k α_k^2 p_{k,t}(1-p_{k,t}) + 2 Σ_{k<j} α_k α_j ρ_{k,j} sqrt(p_{k,t}(1-p_{k,t}) p_{j,t}(1-p_{j,t}))

jaccard_distance.formula: d_J(x, y) = 1 - Σ_i min(x_i, y_i) / Σ_i max(x_i, y_i)

r_CRE.aggregation_formula: x_t = Σ_k α_k · B_{k,t}^{realised}; r-CRE = mean_t x_t

r_CEV.aggregation_formula: x_t = Σ_k α_k · B_{k,t}^{realised}; r-CEV = var_t x_t

mopso_hyperparameters.velocity_update_formula: vel[i] = omega*vel[i] + c1*r1*(gbest_pos - pos[i]) + c2*r2*(pbest_pos[i] - pos[i])
mopso_hyperparameters.mutation_acceptance_rule: accept if new_obj dominates objs[i] OR (objs[i] does not dominate new_obj AND rand() < 0.5)
mopso_hyperparameters.personal_best_update_rule: accept if objs[i] dominates pbest[i] OR (pbest[i] does not dominate objs[i] AND rand() < 0.5)
mopso_hyperparameters.repository_pruning_rule: while length(rep) > N_rep: remove via select_deletion(gamma)

prompt_templates.note: The study contains no LLM system prompt, user prompt, few-shot example, chain-of-thought instruction, retrieval-augmented-generation template, or output-parsing template. All computation is classical statistical estimation and a multi-objective metaheuristic.

network_architecture_parameters.note: The methodology is entirely non-neural. It comprises classical estimators and a multi-objective particle swarm algorithm.

network_training_parameters.note: The only iterative stochastic procedure is MOPSO (Algorithm 1).

neural_network.note: Cited only as external work: Aprea and Sbaiz (2025).

code_and_data_repositories.note: Only Footnote 5: 'Results are available upon request', referring to the mean-variance comparator's active-weight count.

winsorisation.rationale: cleansing step, not a modeling step; the return panel is not partitioned for modeling, so full-sample percentiles introduce no look-ahead bias

judgment_calls_resolved.manuscript_wording: Section 2.1 calls 1960-1990 a '30-year window'
judgment_calls_resolved.decision: inclusive endpoints, 31 obs/month
judgment_calls_resolved.rationale: Task 2 Step 1 requires exactly 31 observations per (continent, calendar_month) over the stated 1960-1990 endpoints

judgment_calls_resolved.manuscript_wording: HAC (Newey-West) robust standard errors is specified for Equation (8) only; the manuscript is silent on the panel (Eq 9-10) standard-error estimator
judgment_calls_resolved.decision: Driscoll-Kraay adopted as the PRIMARY panel estimator; stacked-row Newey-West retained as a labelled sensitivity diagnostic only
judgment_calls_resolved.rationale: within a month every continent's row shares the same sector return and the same market shock, so residuals are strongly cross-sectionally dependent; a Newey-West estimator over stacked rows is invalid for gamma_s/Gamma inference, while Driscoll-Kraay IS a HAC estimator (grouped-sum HAC across months) that respects the panel structure

judgment_calls_resolved.decision: c1 multiplies the leader term (gbest_pos - pos); c2 multiplies the personal-best term (pbest_pos - pos), per Algorithm 1's velocity update and the surrounding prose
judgment_calls_resolved.rationale: Algorithm 1's pseudocode and prose agree with each other but not with the table's own row labels; both values equal 1.5, so no numeric effect follows

judgment_calls_resolved.manuscript_wording: the Task specification does not specify whether the fitted sector universe is checked by count or by exact identity

judgment_calls_resolved.manuscript_wording: 19.7's run_id and fingerprint safeguard only proves anything when both pooling scopes are fit under the SAME run_id from the SAME data

judgment_calls_resolved.rationale: the two sidecars cannot both be written atomically at once, so a driver run always exercises the genuine two-scope safeguard at least once, on the freshly written pair, never on a stale file from an unrelated run

methodological_notes.non_stationarity_claim: Physical climate risk is non-stationary and has intensified in recent decades.
methodological_notes.positive_correlations_claim: All cross-continental Pearson correlations of extreme events are positive, reflecting a common global warming driver.
methodological_notes.bounded_correlation_claim: Bernoulli correlations are bounded in [ρ_min, ρ_max]; pairwise bounds are necessary but not sufficient for K > 2.
methodological_notes.return_materiality_claim: Temperature extremes have a statistically significant negative effect on most sector returns; global Γ = -0.003, p = 0.0096.
methodological_notes.diversifiability_decomposition: CEV = idiosyncratic (Herfindahl) term + systemic (correlation) term; the systemic floor ρ·p·(1-p) is irreducible.
methodological_notes.cev_non_monotonicity: Because p(1-p) peaks at p=0.5, CEV declines as p rises above 0.5, even as CRE increases.
methodological_notes.no_overparameterization: Adding CEV to the mean-variance framework improves diversification.
methodological_notes.transaction_cost_caveat: The backtest excludes transaction costs, bid-ask spreads, and rebalancing costs; reported CAGRs are gross of these frictions.
methodological_notes.universe_reduction_note: Reduction to N=120 is for computational tractability; stratified by market cap and HQ location.
methodological_notes.backend_and_runtime_note: Runtime of 217.39 s per monthly optimization on Intel Core i5, 16 GB RAM, Windows 10 Pro, PyCharm 2025.2.3.
